notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes: [h3]It's only 7 days before [b]Back to Hearth[/b] is coming to Steam. [/h3][p]If you were looking for a short, atmospheric, melancholic autumn game, this is it. [/p][p]5 houses of an abandoned village are waiting. You will need to restore order in the courtyards and inside the houses, restore the feeling of home comfort and kindle a fire in the hearth. All so that the villagers will no longer be afraid to return home.[/p][p][b]September 25th[/b] - save the date.[/p][p]Don't forget to wishlist: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642760/Back_to_Hearth/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642760/Back_to_Hearth/[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="tGeZzV5w_D4;full"][/previewyoutube]
